citation: U.S. Department of Labor, Occupational Safety and Health Administration, accident investigation data, 2015-2025. Public domain. https://data.dol.gov; locations geocoded with the U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder.

events.title: Skid steer rollover into water fatally injures employee
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Montana Railroad Services, Inc. Joliet, MT. An employee was operating a skid steer. The skid steer was found laying on its side with cab under water. The employee drowned.

events.title: Employee dies from head trauma after forklift overturns
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: J Diamond L, Inc. Big Timber, MT. At 3:00 p.m. on June 20, 2024, the owner of a company got a Powered Industrial Truck (PIT) stuck in loose gravel. The owner asked an employee to drive the PIT while he attempted to free it by pulling the truck with his personal vehicle (POV). During the attempt to yank the PIT out, the forklift tipped over, causingfatal injuries to the employee. The employee sustained head trauma from the incident.

events.title: Employee dies from head trauma in fall from roof to concrete…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Industrial Technologies Corporation. Missoula, MT. At 7:45 a.m. on April 3, 2024, an employee working as a structural steel worker for a building contractor was removing decking underlayment from a roof. The employee fell through the roof approximately 15 feet. The employee died from head injuries when he struck the concrete floor.

events.title: Employee drowns while being caught on irrigation pipe
events.description: 1 worker death. Helmville, MT. At 9:00 a.m. on June 26, 2023, an employee was opening an irrigation pipe. The irrigation pipe cover was jammed. The employee tried freeing it with his foot, but his foot got caught in the pipe from water pressure. The employee attempted to free his foot with his hand, but his hand got sucked into the pipe. The employee was stuck under approximately 2-3 foot of water until he drowned.

events.title: Employee is killed when strikes his head into wooden post
events.description: 1 worker death. Three Forks, MT. At 1:45 p.m. on May 9, 2023, an employee was mowing the grounds. The employee took the riding lawn mower behind the shed. When he went under a wooden post, hestruck his head. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall off ladder
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Werco Industries Inc. Libby, MT. At 1:00 p.m. on March 31, 2023, an employee was working from a self supporting ladder. The employee fell off the ladder, hitting his/her head on the asphalt ground. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee installing bird boxes is killed in fall from roof
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Bear Mountain Builders. Whitefish, MT. At 12:30 p.m. on August 31, 2022, an employee was evaluating the materials and tools needed to complete the installation of bird boxes on a roof. The employee stepped on a poorly nailed bird box board and fell 22 feet. The employee incurred blunt force trauma from impacting the ground below and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed due to explosion, smoke inhalation
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Bridger, MT. At 9:30 a.m. on April 20, 2022, an employee was working as a casino attendant/bartender, when there was an explosion due to a gas leak. This created a fire, and the employee was killed due to smoke inhalation.

events.title: Employee is killed when high wind throws employee between mo…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Reay Inc. Billings, MT. At 9:00 a.m. on April 5, 2022, an employee was holding a semi-trailer door open,while another semi was backing up door to door. Wind gusts of up to 70 mph caught the door the employee was holding, which threw the employee in between the moving semi and the parked trailer. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall off lift
events.description: 1 worker death. Hamilton, MT. At 8:00 p.m. on March 28, 2022, an employee was on an elevated lift, putting away mattresses, when he fell approximately 7-8 feet to the concrete ground. The employee suffered multiple skull fractures and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed, crushed by crane which lost pressure
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Anderson Precast & Supply Inc. Bozeman, MT. At 3:00 p.m. on December 2, 2021, an employee was troubleshooting an electrical panel when a truck crane malfunctioned. The employee removed a vital hydraulic component causing release of hydraulic pressure, which caused the crane boom to lower. When the boom lowered, it caught the employee between it and a stabilization block, crushing him under weight of the boom and killing him.

events.title: Employee steps backward on roof, falls and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Elite Construction And Roofing. Bozeman, MT. At 11:00 a.m. on September 21, 2021, an employee took a piece of foam off a stack while stepping backwards. The employee stepped off the roof, fell approximately fourteen feet, and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed when engulfed in fertilizer
events.description: 1 worker death. Wolf Point, MT. At 8:45 p.m. on May 7, 2021, an employee and his coworkers were unloading a fertilizer car when the Urea got stuck. They were using a compressor driven vibrator on each side of the car as well as having employees hit the outside of the car with hammers. The employee and a coworker got up on the car to open the hatch and see if they could dislodge the clumped materials. The employee entered the car to poke the material with rebar when the material dislodged and engulfedhim. The employee died of…

events.title: Employee falls from roof and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Riehl'S Construction. Stevensville, MT. At 9:45 a.m. on April 22, 2021, an employee worked to install an asphalt ridge cap. The employee fell approximately fourteen feet and was killed.

events.title: Employee falls from roof and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Fisher Family Construction, Llc. Stevensville, MT. At 9:45 a.m. on April 22, 2021, an employee worked to install an asphalt ridge cap. The employee fell approximately thirteen feet and was killed.

events.title: One employee is killed and another incurs burns after oil ta…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Silver Bow Truck Center, Inc. Butte, MT. At 4:15 p.m. on March 15, 2021, Employee #1 and Employee #2 were repairing a hole in the spent oil tank when the tank exploded. Employee #1 was killed and Employee #2 was hospitalized with 3rd degree burns and blunt force trauma injuries.

events.title: Employee is electrocuted when ladder contacts power line
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Quality Seamless Gutters Of Montana, Inc. Huson, MT. At 11:30 a.m. on December 21, 2020, Employee #1 and a coworker, employed by a gutters company, were installing snow stops along the roof of a residence. Employee #1 was using a Warner 24-foot aluminum extension ladder that was extended to approximately 18 feet. As he maneuvered the ladder from one side of the roof to the other side, the ladder came into contact with low-hanging, energized power lines. Employee #1 was electrocuted. The coworker, while waiting for emergency services to arrive,…

events.title: Employee loses consciousness, later dies of heart attack
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Billings Family Ymca, Inc. Billings, MT. On August 31, 2020, an employee was cleaning when she lost consciousness in the break room. She later died of a heart attack.

events.title: Employee falls from ladder and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Central Assembly Of God Church Of Great Falls, Montana, Inc. Great Falls, MT. At 2:15 p.m. on June 15, 2020, an employee was working on a 8 foot A frame ladder. The employee lost his balance and fell onto the carpeted concrete basement floor. The employee fractured his skull from the impact with the basement floor and was killed.

events.title: ATV rollover kills employee
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: T-L Irrigation Company. Ennis, MT. At 9:00 a.m. on May 29, 2019, an employee was using an ATV to spray weeds in an irrigation ditch. The employee was killed when the ATV rolled over on him, fracturing his neck.

events.title: Employee is crushed and killed by a large hay bale
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Copper Spring Ranch, Llc. Bozeman, MT. At 7:30 a.m. on January 3, 2019, an employee was loading large square bale containing 21 small bales onto the truck flatbed. The large hay bale fell onto the employee, and crushed the employee between the bale and truck flatbed. The employee sustained blunt force trauma to chest and he was killed. killed.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall off roof
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: K & R Builders. Libby, MT. At 5:00 p.m. on June 18, 2018, Employee #1 was installing Dry-in materials on a roof. The employee fell off of the roof and was killed.

events.title: Employee is struck by a concrete beam and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Fisher Construction, Inc. Billings, MT. At 8:45 a.m. on January 23, 2017, an employee was standing beneath a beam of a building when it came loose and struck him. The employee was crushed and killed.killed.

events.title: Employee dies while performing cleaning operations
events.description: 1 worker death. Missoula, MT. At 3:30 a.m. on February 19, 2017, an employee was bringing a floor scrubber into a filling area. The employee was found unconscious and the employee was killed.

events.title: Employee is crushed by a load of trusses that fell off a tru…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Bmc West, Llc. Kalispell, MT. At 11:00 a.m. on November 30, 2016, an employee was checking tire pressure and/or tread depth on a truck. A load of trusses fell and crushed the employee,resulting in fatal injuries.

events.title: Employee crushed and asphyxiated by truck cab
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: J H Motors, Inc. Billings, MT. At 11:45 a.m. on November 28, 2016, an employee was working underneath the cab of a semi wrecker making mechanical repair on the Jake brake. The employee raised the cab of the semi-truck wrecker in order to make repairs. The cab released from upright position, and his body was caught beneath the cab and the engine exhaust pipe on the right side of the vehicle, when the cab unexpectedly lowered. The employee sustained fatal blunt force trauma and asphyxiation from the weight of the cab.

events.title: Employee falls from truss and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Pearson Construction. Whitefish, MT. At 2:30 p.m. on September 14, 2016, an employee was repairing a truss that appeared to be set crooked. While repairing the truss the employee lost his footing and fell off the roof onto the concrete floor. The employee was killed from a head contusion.

events.title: Employee falls into a pulp dryer and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Billings, MT. At 12:30 p.m. on October 4, 2015, an employee was inspecting a scroll (auger) used to move beet pulp. The employee fell into a pulp dryer and was later found buried under a substantial pile of dried pulp. The employee was asphyxiated. asphyxiated.

events.title: Employee is Killed in Fall from Ladder
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Air Controls-Billings, Inc. Scobey, MT. At approximately 2:00 p.m. on September 4, 2015, an employee was installing ductwork from an eight foot step ladder. The employee fell from ladder while installing ductwork on an exhaust fan and struck his head on the concrete floor.The employee was found unresponsive. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee dies of Respiratory Illness after exposure to Oak s…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Oak Creations, Inc. Columbus, MT. At approximately 8:15 p.m., an employee was killed after 15-year exposure to sawdust and silica. The exposure to sawdust and sandpaper came from making cabinets. The coroners report stated that the employee's lungs were filled withoak sawdust and silica from sandpaper.
